questions.def: Use 'to + infinitive' to express purpose.
questions.question: I went to the shop ___ some milk.

questions.def: 'In order to' shows purpose or intention.
questions.question: She is studying hard ___ pass the exam.

questions.def: Use the present simple for habitual actions to express purpose.
questions.question: She ___ every day in order to get good grades.

questions.def: 'Because of' is followed by a noun phrase.
questions.question: I am late ___ the traffic.

questions.def: 'So' shows the result of an action.
questions.question: It rained a lot, ___ we stayed inside.

questions.def: 'So' indicates a result of working hard.
questions.question: I ___ hard, so I can buy a new car.

questions.def: 'So that' introduces a clause of purpose.
questions.question: He left early ___ he could catch the train.

questions.def: 'In order that' expresses a purpose clause.
questions.question: She saved money ___ she could travel.

questions.def: 'Because' explains the reason for cooking dinner.
questions.question: I ___ dinner because I was hungry.

questions.def: 'Because of' needs a noun phrase after it.
questions.question: ___ the rain, we stayed home.

questions.def: 'Therefore' shows the result of being tired.
questions.question: He was tired, ___ he went to bed.

questions.def: 'So that' introduces a purpose clause.
questions.question: I ___ every day so that I can stay healthy.

questions.def: 'To' indicates purpose followed by the verb.
questions.question: I went to the market ___ buy some fruits.

questions.def: 'As a result' introduces the consequence.
questions.question: She didn't study, ___ she failed the test.

questions.def: 'In order to' shows the purpose of saving.
questions.question: He ___ money in order to buy a house.

questions.def: 'So that' introduces the reason for learning.
questions.question: He is learning to drive ___ he can go on road trips.

questions.def: 'Consequently' indicates the result of the practice.
questions.question: They practiced a lot, ___ they won the game.

questions.def: 'In order to' shows the purpose for eating vegetables.
questions.question: I ___ vegetables in order to stay healthy.

questions.def: 'To' + verb shows the purpose of calling.
questions.question: I called her ___ tell her the news.

questions.def: 'Therefore' indicates the result of feeling sick.
questions.question: He felt sick, ___ he went home.

questions.def: 'Because' explains the reason for drinking.
questions.question: I ___ water because I am thirsty.

questions.def: 'So that' indicates purpose.
questions.question: She is learning English ___ she can travel the world.

questions.def: 'Therefore' shows the result.
questions.question: The store was closed, ___ I couldn't buy anything.

questions.def: 'To' expresses purpose: she studies in order to pass the exam.
questions.question: She studies hard ___ pass the exam.

questions.def: 'Because' introduces the reason why I went to the shop.
questions.question: I went to the shop ___ I needed milk.

questions.def: 'To + base verb' expresses the purpose of going to the library.
questions.question: I am going to the library ___ .

questions.def: 'So that' expresses the purpose of saving money.
questions.question: They saved money ___ they could buy a car.

questions.def: 'So' introduces the result of the rain.
questions.question: It was raining, ___ we stayed at home.

questions.def: 'To + base verb' expresses the purpose of going to the restaurant.
questions.question: He went to the restaurant ___ lunch.

questions.def: 'To' expresses purpose: learning English in order to get a job.
questions.question: I'm learning English ___ get a better job.
